_about.what: An annotated example of one schema-lane file (D7). Copy it to <packet>/schema/<table>.json, one file per table the design adds, changes or leans on, then delete this _about block and every EXAMPLE value. The compiler (scripts/build_tdd.py) reads every *.json in schema/, gives each an id tbl-<table slug>, and the page's drawer (app/src/components/SchemaDrawer.tsx) shows it when a diagram box with a matching table field, or a link to the id, is clicked. references/schema-lane.md explains each field.
_about.table: the real table name; defaults to the file name
_about.state: new (the design adds it) | changed (the design alters it) | existing (unchanged, shown for context); defaults to existing
_about.columns[].change: new | changed | dropped | unchanged. Set it on every column of a changed table: the compiler defaults a missing change to unchanged only when state is existing, and to new otherwise
_about.columns[].type: the SQL type and nullability as the source states them; leave it "" when the source does not state it (the drawer prints 'not stated'), never guess
_about.columns[].was: for a changed column, the previous definition; the drawer shows it struck through
_about.sample_rows: a few rows keyed by column name, shaped like the DDL. Synthetic unless a reviewed, scrubbed export says otherwise; never personal data
_about.sample_source: says where the rows came from, e.g. 'synthetic, shaped like the DDL; not production data'
_about.measured: recorded facts only: each { value, unit, source, date, note?, label? }. source names the query, dashboard, research file or document section; date is when it was measured (the source's date when it gives none, and say so in note). Leave a key out when nothing was measured: the drawer prints 'not measured'. reads, writes, rows and storage always show; any other key is added after them
_about.measured.cost: optional: what the table costs in production, { value, unit, source, date, note? } (for example storage in USD per month, or its share of the database bill), from a billing export or a cost dashboard, never estimated; the schema diagram's table card shows it in its cost measure, with expected.cost beside it as the change after the design, and the table's brief lists both. Absent, the measure reads '–' and the brief 'not measured'
_about.measured.columns: optional: the live table's column count, { value, source, date }, when this file lists only the columns the design names; the card's cols measure shows it (else the count of this file's columns, dropped ones left out) with the design's change (+new, −dropped) beside it
_about.expected: the design's own reasoning about load after the change: each { value?, unit?, note, label? }. note quotes or cites the basis. A key with a note and no value prints 'not estimated' plus the note
_about.ddl: the CREATE or ALTER statements, verbatim from the design
_about.indexes: keys, indexes and constraints, one string each
_about.notes: short facts a reviewer needs; `backticks` render as code
_about.tradeoffs: optional (D28): what the design gains and costs for this table, two or three terse lines from the TDD's own text, never invented: [{ gain, cost }] or ["…"] (a string starting with + or 'gain:' is a gain, with − or 'cost:' a cost). The table's brief (the diagram card's hover card and the drawer's Details tab) shows them as + and − bullets; absent, the block is hidden
_about.summary: one paragraph; its first sentence is the table's purpose line in the brief (the drawer shows all of it)

summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. A staff member offering a shift to a colleague. The design adds a withdrawn status and its time, and drops a legacy flag nothing reads.

tradeoffs.gain: EXAMPLE: a withdrawal is recorded with its time instead of deleting the offer (quote the design)
tradeoffs.cost: EXAMPLE: one more status every reader of the table must handle

columns.name: legacy_flag
columns.note: no reader since the 2025 migration (cite the grep)

sample_source: synthetic, shaped like the DDL; not production data

writes.source: EXAMPLE: the query, dashboard or research file that produced it
writes.note: what the count includes (all tenants? test tenants?)
EXAMPLE: quote the design line that implies it

storage.note: EXAMPLE: no estimate; a key with only a note prints 'not estimated'

notes: EXAMPLE: only the columns the design names are listed; say so when the live table has more.
